summary: The customer called in extremely angry because a previous agent hung up on him and was rude. The agent apologized profusely, handled his complaints about the previous representative, logged an official complaint with reference number 58492, unblocked his internet, and applied a bill settlement.

evidence.text: هسا بشيل الحظر عن النت فوراً وبعمل لك تسوية على الفاتورة
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Remove internet block immediately and process a bill settlement

evidence.text: وخلال دقيقتين بكون النت رجع شغال عندك، والشكوى انبعثت للإدارة مع رقم مرجعي
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Restore internet within two minutes and send complaint to management with a reference number

evidence.text: والله يا أستاذ بعتذر منك، ما بقدر أعطيك الاسم الشخصي
evidence.speaker: Agent

compliance_flags.description: Agent refused to provide the employee ID or name of the agent who hung up, which frustrated the customer further.

evidence.text: أستاذ، بتأسف كتير منشان اللي صار معك، ممكن تعطيني رقم الخط أو تفاصيل المشكلة؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained composure despite the customer's high anger, though withholding the offending employee's name caused tension.

evidence.text: بحقك علي وألف آسف على هالتصرف غير المهني أبداً.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent repeatedly validated the customer's frustration and offered genuine-sounding apologies on behalf of the company.

evidence.text: حالياً السيستم عم بيحدث، وخلال دقيقتين بكون النت رجع شغال عندك، والشكوى انبعثت للإدارة مع رقم مرجعي.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully addressed both the behavioral complaint and the technical/billing issue by promising an unblock, settlement, and logging the formal complaint.

evidence.text: رقم الشكوى هو ٥٨٤٩٢، وبتصل علينا لو احتجت أي إشي ثاني، شكراً لصبرك معنا يا أستاذ.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: Clear and polite instructions were given, providing the reference number and confirming the timeline for the internet restoration.

evidence.text: بتصل علينا لو احتجت أي إشي ثاني، شكراً لصبرك معنا يا أستاذ.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent closed the call professionally with a thank you for patience and an offer for further assistance, though the customer ended with a threat of regulatory escalation.

evidence.text: هسا بشيل الحظر عن النت فوراً وبعمل لك تسوية على الفاتورة
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent provided actionable and accurate solutions regarding the billing settlement and internet restoration.

evidence.text: أستاذ، بتأسف كتير منشان اللي صار معك، ممكن تعطيني رقم الخط أو تفاصيل المشكلة؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: Followed complaint logging procedures and issued a reference number, but withheld the specific employee ID requested by the customer.

quote.text: I just called five minutes ago and the agent who answered me was unbelievably rude!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: I want to speak with your manager right now!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: What is his name? Give me his employee ID!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: That doesn't fix anything! الزلمة صرخ بوجهي وسكر الخط!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: يا عمي أنا مش عم بطلب مزايا، أنا بطلب حقي!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: طيب، هات رقم الشكوى لنشوف، وإن ما انتبهت لقصة الموظف، والله لأقدم شكوى لهيئة تنظيم الاتصالات!
quote.speaker: Customer
